prompts.name: 01-arrival
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production storyboard for section 01, Arrival, of the Carlisle Coast bonus platform game. Input image 1 is the exact player-camera screenshot to redraw; image 2 is the established Carlisle Coast material and environment reference. Keep image 1's camera, side-on perspective, player size and position, supported horizontal route silhouette, right-edge crate stack and fruit positions. Replace the crude warehouse scenery with a richly sculpted mossy sandstone ravine consistent with image 2: thick fractured ochre ledges, deep recessed rock seams, olive turf, sparse delicate grass, ferns and coral leaves in crevices, weathered carved temple remnants behind the path. Background has layered sage-gray canyon silhouettes fading into luminous warm mist and a quiet cream/sage clouded sky. A few old timber cargo hoists made of rough split wood sit on the distant ruined quay; retain the cargo setting without modern buildings. The ground must be a substantial irregular stone landmass rather than a thin rectangular slab. Use high-quality textured stylized 3D game rendering, clear broad forms, warm soft directional light, rich contact shadows, restrained fine detail. Keep the traversable top at exactly the same screen height and keep the character legible. Render a complete edge-to-edge landscape frame, no panels, no writing, no UI or HUD. Do not move the camera, add gameplay obstacles, or put foreground masses in front of the player.

There must be empty unobstructed jump space up to the high crate. Place the main weathered wooden cargo hoist behind the puzzle, several metres behind its jump line, above low carved sandstone ruins. Keep camera position, side-on perspective, character scale, every gameplay object position, and traversable floor height from image 1; remove all HUD text/icons. Replace primitive warehouses and flat box floors with warm ochre deeply sculpted sandstone, olive turf, sparse fine grass, ferns and coral foliage, weathered carved temple piers and rope-lashed split-timber hoists. Behind the playable path compose several separated depth layers of rock and ruins, then distant sage canyon towers and warm sunlit mist below a soft cream cloud sky. Match image 2's high quality textured stylized 3D rendering, rounded fractured edges and contact shading, substantial geological roots below landings. Keep all non-gameplay architecture behind the play plane. Landscape, edge-to-edge, no panels, no writing, no UI. No camera change, no new gameplay obstacles, no foreground blockers.
